title: Overwhelming Force
desc: Win a battle with at least five times the enemy's strength.

title: Not One Left Standing
desc: Destroy an enemy army completely in a single battle.

title: Seasoned Commander
desc: Win 10 battles.

title: Conqueror
desc: Conquer 20 regions in war.

title: Master of Europe
desc: Rule 40 regions at once.

title: Glory Everlasting
desc: Reach 90 prestige.

title: Solvent Great Power
desc: Rule 100 development without owing a single loan.

title: A New Imperial Dynasty
desc: Become Holy Roman Emperor as any house but the Habsburgs of Austria.

title: Kaiser and Reich
desc: As Emperor, rule the Empire's great principalities yourself: Austria, Bohemia, Bavaria, Saxony, Brandenburg, Swabia, the Palatinate and Cologne.

title: Champion of the Reformation
desc: As a Protestant realm of 15 regions or more, see 25 regions of Europe turn Protestant.

title: Italia
desc: Rule all of Italy from the Alps to Sicily.

title: A Latin Empire Again
desc: As a Catholic realm, rule Constantinople.

title: A Swift End to a Long War
desc: As France, drive the English from Normandy, Gascony and Calais before 1453.

title: Lions Still in France
desc: As England, still hold Normandy, Gascony and Calais in 1500.

title: Faster Than Isabella
desc: As Castile, take Granada before 1492.

title: Hispania
desc: Rule every region of the Iberian peninsula.

title: Pepper and Gold
desc: As Portugal, hold 1,500 gold in your treasury.

title: The Middle Kingdom
desc: As Burgundy, rule every land from Holland to the Alps, including Lorraine, Champagne, Swabia and Switzerland.

title: Happy Austria, Marry
desc: As Austria, rule or hold as subjects Bohemia, Hungary and Burgundy (or its Flemish heartland).

title: The Raven King
desc: As Hungary, rule Austria, Moravia and Silesia.

title: Commonwealth of Two Nations
desc: As Poland or Lithuania, bring the other under your crown, by union or by conquest.

title: The Third Rome
desc: As Muscovy, rule both Moscow and Constantinople.

title: All the Russias
desc: As Muscovy, rule Moscow, Tver, Novgorod, Ryazan, Pskov, Karelia, Smolensk and Kiev.

title: Ahead of History
desc: As the Ottomans, take Constantinople before 1453.

title: The Golden Apple
desc: As the Ottomans, rule Hungary and Austria.

title: Stato da Mar
desc: As Venice, rule Dalmatia, Albania, the Morea, Candia, Cyprus and Rhodes with 40 ships at sea.

title: The Auld Enemy Humbled
desc: As Scotland, take London.

title: Kalmar Endures
desc: As Denmark, still hold Sweden as your junior partner, or rule it outright, in 1523.

title: Lion of the North
desc: As Sweden, rule Scania, Livonia, Pomerania and Prussia and win 15 battles.

title: From Sand to Kingdom
desc: As Brandenburg, rule Brandenburg, Pomerania, Prussia and Silesia.

title: Rome and the Two Sicilies
desc: As Naples, rule Naples, Apulia, Sicily and Rome.

title: The Order Stands
desc: As the Teutonic Order, still hold Danzig and Prussia in 1525.

title: The City Endures
desc: As Byzantium, still hold Constantinople in 1500.

title: Restore the Roman Empire
desc: As Byzantium, rule Constantinople, Rome and Naples, all of Greece and Thrace, Bulgaria, Bithynia and Aydın.
